request.title: B.0.B., deadly to impostors
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: a torch-lit hall. Tiny B.0.B. leaps through the air, a small blade raised, at a looming shadowy shapeshifter whose disguise is peeling away; a bunch of grapes spills across the floor. Fierce and funny. Characters: B.0.B.: a small round brass construct about knee height with one large eye, red lips and thin clockwork limbs, hovering slightly off the ground.
